label: r04-F-T3-3
critiques: trialPrompt passes only the config file, triage/, and the ticket text. It says "Do not open, list, search, or print anything under spe/evals/, spe/predictions/, spe/plans/". Those paths cover grade.py, answers.json, judge.md, and r04.yaml. Any reported read is marked void_peeked and halts the run.

args.only limits the run to named cells such as "B:T-1042". Gate 3 runs a dry run on one B cell and one C2 cell with 2 trials and a $3 cap before the real run. The dry run's measured costs feed estTrialUsd, estAgentUsd, and estJudgeUsd.

Gate 1 is a grader selftest. It checks that the oracle passes and that empty and all-wrong prediction files fail. Gate 2 regrades round 3's saved outputs with this round's grade.py and compares them to round 3's recorded scores.

CAP defaults to 40. reserve() runs before every trial, grade, judge, and synthesis call. When a call would cross the cap, reserve() pushes the item to skipped and logs "SKIP ... would cross the $40 cap". settle() then corrects the reserved amount to the actual cost.
gradeCell runs grade.py on label.category and label.priority, and pass is category_ok && priority_ok. The judge prompt says "You score tone only. Category and priority are graded elsewhere."
The Top-up phase picks cells where passes > 0 and passes < graded. It adds TOPUP_PER_CELL (5) trials to each, for at most TOPUP_MAX_CELLS (30) cells. Cells over the cell cap are logged in skipped.
The Synthesis phase runs a failure analysis agent and then a completeness critic. ROUND comes from args.round, and RR, OUT, and PREDICTIONS are all built from it.
